Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, rapture! This is my favorite part of the Danville Harbor Day's festival! The annual shark reenactment. Let's checketh it out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: "Checketh it out?" Really?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I stand by my Old English. Oh, look, they're doing the song!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And that is why we celebrate Harbor Day every year with a reenactment. Here cometh the shark.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look at me, I'm a shark! I can poop in the ocean!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But you are not going to, right?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Keep pushing, dweeb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. They really should put more effort into the shark. Ferb, I knoweth what we're going to doeth today!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hey, whereth is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Happy Harbor Day, Agent P! In honor of the occasion, we've flooded your headquarters. Hope you like it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Actually, our plumbing just backed up.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just trying to put a happy face on it, Carl. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted on a... boat. Go check it out. (Perry leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Brother, these Harbor Days festivals are so lame. I can't wait to see this year's lame-o replica of the great white shark of Danville Harbor!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's always so feeble.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. (she and Stacy laugh; she hears helicopters) What's that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, let 'er drop! (the shark splashes down near the small boat Phineas and Ferb are in, causing a huge wave that drenches only Candace)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, now how did that only hit me?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look at that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (rowing up to the shark) Let's go, Ferb! We're gonna give this year's Harbor Day's reenactment the best shark ever! (they enter the shark)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Rrrrr... Come on, Stacy. We've got a shark to bust!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: So I says, "Keep your hands off my poop deck, then we'll keelhaul the scurvy!"

Name: Candace
Dialog: (running up with Stacy) Yo ho, Captain Kidd, we need your ship. My brothers are in that shark!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: 'Tis the same beast that swallowed my leg...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pushing him up the gangplank) Yeah, yeah, that's fascinating. Tell me after we shove off!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: (while walking over the very long gangplank to his smaller boat) Ah, that shark's a mean one. Took me leg just to pick his teeth. He drives alone in the carpool lane. He threw poor Timmy down the well. And he won't give up his seat for little old ladies on the bus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (while pushing Captain Squint up the gangplank) Uh-huh, uh-huh. Yeah. Uh-huh. sure. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. (Snores) Uh-huh. Oh, yeah. Uh-huh. Yeah, I know, he sounds like a bad guy.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Oh, you think!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. Let's see what this baby can do! (Phineas pilots the shark out to sea) Looks like everything's shark-shape! (moves away, revealing Ferb controlling the fins and tail using a mechanical bodysuit) Make a left... (the shark turns left) Let's get our cartilaginous vertebrate on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (opens hole to hold) Perry the Platypus! (Perry chatters) So what am I doing out here? Well I'll tell you. One day, while I was perusing my collection of 19th-century almanacs, I learned that the leading cause of tooth decay is saltwater taffy! And that's why I invented the Saltwater Taffy-inator! Y-you can't see it from here; I built it on the bottom of the ocean where I have an unlimited supply of salt water for free. I-I'm going to make the sweetest, gooiest, stickiest saltwater taffy in the world!! In the world. Enough to give cavities to every kid in the Tri-State Area! Ha-HA-ha-ha-ha! (shuts opening) Now where's my wetsuit?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where are they? All I need is a metal shark and a mom to bust her by!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: That one's got some wind in her sails.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You have no idea. So, did a shark really eat your leg?

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Arr, probably. But he definitely chewed on my arm. (shows Stacy a small mark on his arm)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uhh, that's just a birthmark.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: ...I'm tired of this conversation.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thar she blows!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: I see you, Mister Beast! (spins the ship's wheel)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can't this tug go any faster?

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: There be only one captain on this ship.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like the reenactment has started! Let's give 'em a run for their money, Ferb! (Ferb salutes; so does the shark) They're still on our tail! (the shark leaps out of the water and splashes down in front of the Pea-quad)

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: He be toying with us.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ayeee!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cannonball, Ferb. (the shark leaps out of the sea)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well at least we'll all get wet. (the shark splashes down, only soaking Candace; she shouts to the sky) Really? Really?? (an octopus lands on Captain Squint's face)

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Arr! It's the octopus that ate me pancreas!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to the sky) Thank you.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Get back here, beast! (the shark sends the Pea-quad flying with a tail flick)

Name: Candace, Stacy, Captain Squint
Dialog: Whoa! (the Pea-quad skips across the sea)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, six skips! (to Ferb) Nice going.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Here we go. (rolls backwards off the stern but lands on a metal grate) Ow! Oh, okay, that hurt. All right, better just, uh... (prods the water with his spear gun) Okay, I'm good. (jumps off his boat and swims down to the Saltwater Taffy-inator; he pushes a button) Now I will activate my Saltwater Taffy-inator. (turns a handle; the -inator begins spinning taffy) At last! Now nothing can prevent me from promoting tooth decay! Ha-HA-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha... (fogs up his scuba mask) Aw, I fogged up my mask again! (clears his mask to reveal Perry in a wetsuit swimming towards him; Perry punches him backwards) Perry the Platypus? How did you get out? (Perry flashes back to the crabs forming a ladder, but Doofenshmirtz grabs him from behind) Ha! I grabbed you while you were flashing back to your escape! Hee-hee-hee... drbt! (Perry kicks him and starts swimming away)

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: Yikes!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: (holding a fishing rod with the cheese hook) I caught many a fish with this lure. (casts the hook at the shark, catching it) Take the pole and I'll man the wheel! (lets go of the rod, causing it to yank the two girls forward)

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Stacy, pull! (Stacy and Candace try to pull the rod)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Rubber ducks? Are you serious?!?

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Does a penguin fly?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Aw, now I'm tired of this conversation too! (leaves)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: The ducks are back!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: (emerges from the head holding a plunger attached to a rope) I'll harpoon the beast!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's a plunger.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: I didn't buy this ship for its plumbing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yahhh! Swim for your life! (the taffy engulfs Perry and Doofenshmirtz and starts spinning them around)

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Come to Papa, beast. Well, I-I ain't really a papa; I-I never had kids of my own, see, and... if I did they probably wouldn't be... sharks, but... you know what I mean! (the shark emerges at the stern) Ohhh... ohh!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, he reaches!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: We're gonna need a bigger captain.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cheese and sausage?

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: So this is what the inside of a shark looks like? I always thought it would be more... stomach-y.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think maybe it's time we just call it quits.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (putting on Captain Squint's hat and wielding his harpoon) Stacy, I'm tired of this conversation!(lightning strikes behind them)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (trapped in the taffy) Ha-HA! I still have the upper hand! (the taffy spinner rotates, moving Perry above Doofenshmirtz) Well, actually you may at this particular mo... (the taffy squishes them together, then separates them again) Chew first, Perry the Plat... ahhh!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hoist the mainsail! (Stacy does so) Swab the poop deck! (Stacy does so) Watch that jib, sailor. (the jib knocks Stacy's hat off) Now take the helm! (puts Stacy at the wheel and rides a rope onto the bowsprit) I've got a date with destiny, and it ain't gonna end with a kiss! (spots the shark through a spyglass) You've vexed me for too long. Too long! Full speed ahead, Stacy; get me in close!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Aye aye, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Captain!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Captain! (aside) Yikes, what is it about that hat?

Name: Candace
Dialog: From Danville Harbor I stab at thee; for busting's sake I spit my last spit at thee! (spits onto the plunger's bell) Unh! (hurls the plunger at the shark's fin, where it sticks) Head for shore, Stacy! We got him! (the ship turns for shore, hauling the shark with it)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (looking through a window in the shark) Say, whoever's on that boat has the story wrong. They're supposed to drive us out to sea, not drag us into shore! Looks like we're gonna need a bigger shark. (pulls a handle, making the shark grow in size; the grown shark starts dragging the Pea-quad out to sea)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now I wish I'd made that "OFF" button more accessible from the taffy itself. (sighs; he and Perry are completely trapped in the taffy) I wonder how this is affecting the surface water.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is that the best you've got?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (emerging from the head with a handful of plungers) I found more harpoons! And I'm gonna pretend these have never been used!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Load the cannon! (Stacy loads all the plungers into the cannon) Stand clear! (Candace lights the cannon, which fires; however, a rope loops around Candace's ankle and pulls her off the ship)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (clicks her tongue) Yep.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (roped to the shark; screams and bangs on the shark) I know you be in there!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: (banging on the inside wall with a large fishhook) I'm-a gettin' us outta here, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We need more power, Ferb! (Ferb lashes the shark's tail rapidly)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hard a-starboard, Stacy! (Stacy turns the wheel port, turning the ship and shark around) Okay, that's port, but whatever!

Name: Puppet man
Dialog: Arr! Arr!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You know, it's such a shame the reenactment can't be this exciting.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: A-ha-ha-ha! Free at last! Thanks for me new leg, boys! (his leg fires a rocket engine and Captain Squint flies away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Look, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, Mom! Look at the shark!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What? (removes her wet bonnet and two starfish covering her eyes) Oh, that? (sees Buford and Baljeet in their "shark" costume) They get cheesier every year.

Name: Buford
Dialog: ROAR!! (starts shaking Baljeet)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You cannot attack me; I am the tail!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (yanks up Baljeet by the tail) Shark wedgie!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walks up to them) That's not what I meant! (takes her hat off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: It never is, honey. (at the kids) Who wants blood pudding?

Name: Phineas, Buford, Baljeet
Dialog: Me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, this much I could've predicted, but I'm having a hard time explaining the giant metal shark. (sighs as the shark is pulled towards them by the taffy) Well, at least we'll go together, Perry the Platypus. (Perry ejects from his wetsuit through the scuba helmet and swims away) Oh sure, I reach out to you and then you use the emergency face plate ejector thing. (the shark crashes into Doofenshmirtz, the taffy, and the -inator, creating a cloud of bubbles)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Plat-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: -ypus!
